messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Two knowledge-graph relations extracted from drug information texts are given below. Decide whether they express the same meaning with the same subject/object direction, so that they can be merged into one relation without losing information.

Relation A: 'may have ph adjusted with' defined as 'The pH of the subject drug may be modified using the substance or chemical specified by the object entity.'
Example triple with A: ["Ozempic", "may have ph adjusted with", "hydrochloric acid or sodium hydroxide"]
Relation B: 'has dose adjustment based on' defined as 'The dosage of the subject drug may be modified according to the factor specified by the object entity.'
Example triple with B: ["fluoxetine", "has dose adjustment based on", "response to treatment"]

Can every use of relation A be replaced by relation B? Answer with only "yes" or "no".
Answer:
